$comment: FROZEN MIRROR of the NEXUS HOST Content-Security-Policy. This file is the CONTRACT this remote is built against. It is NOT read by the browser and NOT served — it is the machine-readable spec that scripts/check-csp.cjs enforces against ui/dist/ at build time, and the source for the <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> block in public/index.html used for standalone dev parity. DO NOT WIDEN IT to make a build pass. If your remote genuinely needs a directive the host does not grant, that is a HOST change (server/lib/csp.ts + deployment/lib/common.sh) requested from the platform team — not a local edit here. Widening this file only hides the failure until production.
criticalNote: When your remote is EMBEDDED, the document origin is the HOST origin. Every 'self' below therefore means THE HOST — never your Container App origin. Only the directives listed in 'grantsRemoteOrigin' extend to your origin; everything else is host-only and your asset WILL be blocked.

envExtras.$comment: The host's CSP_*_SRC_EXTRA App Settings are ADDITIVE-ONLY and are RESET FROM remotes.json ON EVERY HOST DEPLOY (deployment/lib/common.sh). A hand-typed `az webapp config appsettings set CSP_..._EXTRA` hotfix to unblock your remote is silently WIPED on the next host deploy. Treat these values as FIXED.

CSP_SCRIPT_SRC_EXTRA.derivedFrom: src/config/remotes.json (host) — your `origin` lands here automatically once you are registered

CSP_STYLE_SRC_EXTRA.note: Your remote origin is ALSO in style-src (derived from script-src), so your own extracted .css chunks load fine. This setting exists only for the host's Google Fonts stylesheet. Do NOT expect any other stylesheet CDN.

CSP_FONT_SRC_EXTRA.note: font-src does NOT include remote origins. A self-hosted .woff2 served from YOUR Container App is BLOCKED when embedded. Inline fonts as data: URLs, or use fonts.gstatic.com / cdn.jsdelivr.net.

CSP_FRAME_SRC_EXTRA.note: Empty. You may not iframe a third-party origin from inside your remote.

CSP_REPORT_ONLY.lockedValue: true in dev/demo, false (ENFORCING) in prod
CSP_REPORT_ONLY.note: A violation that is merely REPORTED in demo becomes a hard BLOCK in prod. Never ship on the strength of 'it worked in demo'.

forbiddenInRemoteBundles.$comment: Concrete build outputs that this policy blocks. scripts/check-csp.cjs fails the build on each of these.
forbiddenInRemoteBundles.eval: script-src has NO 'unsafe-eval'. Forbids eval(), new Function(), and any webpack devtool that emits eval (eval, eval-source-map, eval-cheap-*). Use 'source-map' / 'hidden-source-map' in production.
forbiddenInRemoteBundles.inlineScript: script-src has NO 'unsafe-inline' and NO nonce/hash is passed to remotes. Every <script> must be an external file from your origin. No inline <script> in any HTML you inject.
forbiddenInRemoteBundles.selfHostedFonts: font-src excludes remote origins. Bundle fonts as data: URLs (webpack asset/inline) or point at fonts.gstatic.com / cdn.jsdelivr.net.
forbiddenInRemoteBundles.webWorkerFromOrigin: worker-src is 'self' blob: only. new Worker('/worker.js') from your origin is blocked; construct workers from a Blob URL instead.
forbiddenInRemoteBundles.mediaFromOrigin: There is NO media-src directive, so <audio>/<video> fall back to default-src 'self' = the HOST origin. Media served from your Container App is BLOCKED.
forbiddenInRemoteBundles.webManifest: manifest-src is 'self'. Your remote must not link a .webmanifest.
forbiddenInRemoteBundles.objectEmbed: object-src 'none'. No <object>, <embed>, or <applet> — including PDF embeds. Use an <iframe> only if the platform team adds your origin to frame-src.

allowedInRemoteBundles.inlineStyle: style-src includes 'unsafe-inline', so React `style={{}}` props and injected <style> blocks are permitted. style-loader therefore works — but extracted .css is still preferred (see webpack.config.js).
allowedInRemoteBundles.externalCssFromOrigin: Your remote origin IS in style-src (the host derives style-src from script-src), so <link rel=stylesheet> to your own hashed .css chunks is allowed.
allowedInRemoteBundles.imagesAnyHttps: img-src allows 'self' data: blob: https: — images from anywhere over https are fine.
allowedInRemoteBundles.dataUriFonts: font-src includes data:, so base64-inlined fonts always work.
